reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis assumes a B2 phase can precipitate in an equal-atomic NbMoTaW alloy, but this system is known to be a stable single-phase BCC solid solution without a miscibility gap or intermetallic formation tendency, making the proposed precipitation mechanism physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is detailed and would clearly falsify the hypothesis if no B2 precipitates form or if properties degrade, but the test is moot given the implausibility of the starting premise.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a microstructural intervention (B2 precipitation) that is fundamentally incompatible with the known phase stability of the NbMoTaW alloy, misleading research direction.
